skills.description: Batch code work, filter logs, search indexed docs and diagnose context or cache usage.

readmeMarkdown:
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · **English** # agy-dart **Google Antigravity plugin — Save tokens · Improve cache hits · Keep cache warm on demand · Catch silent background quota burn · Rescue stalled chats** Zero extra dependencies · Works automatically in the background · Built-in right-sidebar dashboard [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10b981.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or 24+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22.16%2B_(22.x)_or_24%2B-38bdf8.svg)](package.json) [![Security Policy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Policy-818cf8.svg)](SECURITY.md) [![Glama MCP](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/zou172866/agy-dart) [![Clones](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/repo-traffic-archive/main/badges/Antigravity-agy-dart.json)](https://github.com/zou172866/repo-traffic-archive) [How to Install](#how-to-install) · [Changelog](#changelog) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Third-Party Notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

--- ## What does this plugin do? `agy-dart` is a token-saving, cache-watching, and session-rescue plugin built for **Google Antigravity** (also supports DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and Codex via `--target`). Once installed, it runs quietly in the background — **no new commands to memorize, just chat and code as usual**: ### 1. Combine small steps into fewer turns When the AI needs to search several terms, it runs them in one batch; when it edits multiple files, it edits them together and runs checks in the same step instead of resending your entire chat history turn after turn. ### 2. Block noisy output & read large files smartly If a test run dumps 3,000 lines of logs, the plugin passes only the key failure lines to the AI (e.g., line 42 failed, the other 199 passed) and keeps the full log locally for lookup. On huge code files, it hands over a line-numbered outline first so the AI reads only the lines it needs. ### 3. Monitor cache & keep it warm on demand The plugin keeps the controllable start of each request steady and cuts down repeated reads of unchanged files; actual cache hit rates still depend on how Antigravity builds requests and how the backend caches them (if you use a dynamic rotating proxy, pinning a single exit node is a useful controlled check). Automatic warming and expiry desktop alerts start off; once enabled, the default limit is 1 warm-up per chat until your next message, and both the count and interval can be changed in the panel. ### 4. Right-sidebar dashboard & crash/hang rescue See at a glance how much context space is left, how many minutes until cache expiry, and how much noise has been blocked. With multiple project windows open, if a background chat runs low on context or gets stuck spinning with zero output, a desktop alert names that project and chat — click it to jump right there. If a chat stalls or hits the limit, copy a progress summary in one click and continue in a fresh chat. ### 5. Catch silent background quota burn (Safety Monitor) Antigravity can occasionally re-review long chats in the background and quietly burn through your 5-hour quota or trigger 429 errors. The plugin watches local logs automatically (and keeps history even if a restart wipes the log): when everything is calm it stays collapsed to one quiet line; if a burn burst or quota cliff hits, the panel expands in plain language and gives you a one-click **Pack Progress & New Chat** button to stop the bleed. ### Other built-in features 1. **Keep your place after `/compact`**: Tracks modified files, latest test/build status, and saved reference IDs in the background so the AI picks right back up after compacting. 2. **Local search for long docs & web pages**: Saves multi-thousand-word docs or web pages locally by section and pulls only matching snippets by keyword. 3. **Filter huge logs & tables locally first**: On multi-MB logs, CSVs, or huge JSON dumps, the AI runs a quick local script to summarize (e.g., top 5 failing endpoints) and brings only the answer into chat; big JSON blobs automatically surface error rows. 4. **Workspace map on new chats**: Gives the AI a compact folder layout, script list, and core-file overview as soon as a new chat starts. 5. **Loop warnings**: Shows a UI-only note (never injected into model context) when the AI gets stuck in `edit → fail → revert → fail` cycles. 6. **Secret masking & sensitive-file protection**: Masks API keys and tokens in logs or web pages, blocks accidental reads of `.env` files when configured, and stops untrusted Git configs from running external commands. 7. **Keep tool replies under 8.8 KB**: Antigravity spills tool replies above ~10 KB into a temp file that costs an extra read turn; the plugin stays inside 8.8 KB and shifts leftover space from short passing checks to real error stack traces. 8. **Usage breakdown, inline diagnostic cards & one-click updates**: Inspect how much context goes to file reads, terminal output, or subagents, view 15-turn cache trends, see interactive inline cards when running `ctx_stats` / `ctx_doctor` (with one-click jump pills to open the side panel on Antigravity `v2.35.1+`), update right from the panel top bar, or replay past chats via CLI to estimate cache hits and warming cost. 9. **Plays nicely with your Skills + Skills bloat check**: Your Skills handle workflows while `agy-dart` quietly guards file reads, trims logs, and watches cache underneath; run `node bin/agy-dart.mjs audit skills` to see how much startup context each installed Skill uses. > Antigravity updates frequently — click **Star** at the top right to follow compatibility updates. --- ## How to Install Requires **Node.js 22.16+ (22.x) or Node.js 24+**. Zero third-party packages — the installer checks that Node's built-in SQLite search engine (FTS5 with trigram) is ready. ### Option 1: One-line terminal install (no clone needed) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.10.1/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart/v1.10.1/install.sh | sh ``` ### Option 2: Let Antigravity install it Send this to Antigravity: ```text Clone tag v1.10.1 of https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git to a temp folder, run `node scripts/install.mjs install` (add `--install-rg` on Windows if `rg` is missing), and confirm `doctor` passes. ``` ### Option 3: Clone & install with custom flags ```powershell git clone --branch v1.10.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/zou172866/Antigravity-agy-dart.git cd Antigravity-agy-dart # Windows PowerShell (optional -InstallRg auto-installs ripgrep) .\install.ps1 -InstallRg # macOS / Linux ./install.sh ``` **Other commands:** ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install # Global install (auto-syncs GEMINI_HOME & T3 ACP if present) node scripts/install.mjs install --project /repo/path # Single-project install node scripts/install.mjs doctor # Check install health node scripts/install.mjs uninstall # Uninstall ``` Restart or reload Antigravity after installing and open a new chat. Your own `rules/*.local.md` files are preserved across upgrades. If you previously installed standalone `agy-fast` or `antigravity-plugin-context-mode`, disable the old ones in your plugin list. Saved document indexes and usage history live locally in `~/.agy-dart/context.db` and stay intact on uninstall. To clear the current chat's index before uninstalling, call `ctx_purge` (when the host omits a session ID, this clears unattributed data for the current workspace); pass `scope: "all"` to wipe all projects. Global uninstall also removes installer-tracked Gemini/T3 copies and lists any older untracked copies with a dedicated removal command instead of deleting blindly. --- ## Settings Everyday switches live right in the **agy-dart Context** side panel: - **Auto-Keepalive (off by default)**: Turn it on for the current chat in the panel, or click **Warm 1×** next to the countdown anytime for a single manual ping. Use **Global Warm** to set the default count and schedule (**Auto**, **Fixed 4 / 9 / 15 min**, or **Custom 1–60 min**). Turning warming off for a chat also silences its expiry and limit alerts. > Note: Each warm-up asks the model for a short `OK` reply and uses input tokens (or the full conversation if the cache already expired). - **Desktop alerts (off by default)**: Cache expiry, stalled-chat alerts, and background quota burn alerts (**Burn Alert: OFF/ON**) all start off and can be toggled individually. - **One-click & automatic updates**: Click **Check Update** / **Update Now** in the top bar anytime, or toggle **Auto-Update: OFF/ON** (off by default) for silent same-major upgrades. - **Other panel controls**: Pause protection, clear old local data, and adjust file-size limits directly in the panel. Preset read limits & tool-loading modes via CLI: ```bash node scripts/install.mjs mode host-45k # Default: direct read up to 45 KB code / 128 KB patches, block >16 KB noisy logs node scripts/install.mjs mode balanced-16k # Outline first above 16 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode fast-32k # Raise normal file limit to 32 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode strict-8k # Block above 8 KB node scripts/install.mjs mode no-read-hook # Never block file reads, only trim noisy terminal output node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading fast-eager # Default: 4 fast tools eager, 8 context tools lazy node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy # All 12 tools lazy-loaded node scripts/install.mjs tool-loading eager # All 12 tools eager-loaded ```
Troubleshooting: ide-tools duplicate /required schema error If Antigravity fails during toolbox initialization with `building toolbox: tool "mcp_ide-tools_mcp_agy-dart_fast_apply_edits" advertises an invalid parameter schema ... at '/required': items at 1 and 2 are equal`, the host's `ide-tools` bridge is duplicating `toolSummary` in `/required`. Switch to lazy loading and restart Antigravity: ```bash node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/scripts/install.mjs tool-loading lazy ``` (Or remove `"tools"` / `"eager": true` under `mcpServers.fast` in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-dart/mcp_config.json` and restart. See [skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md](skills/agy-dart/references/error-playbook.md) for diagnostics.)

latestReleaseNotes:
## Highlights (`v1.10.1`)

Protects Antigravity `1.5.17+` users from the **~4× custom/plugin agent quota multiplier** ([antigravity-cli#1890](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/issues/1890)) while preserving full compatibility with `v1.10.0` in-place self-updates and automatic stale-file cleanup:

### 1. Removed Bundled Custom Agents (`#1890` 4× Quota Protection)
- Removed `agents/dart-coder.md` and `agents/dart-reviewer.md` (plus cleaned `agents/` from `scripts/package-manifest.json`, `package.json`, and `scripts/verify-package-graph.mjs`).
- Use the default main session or official built-in `self` / `research` subagents (1× standard quota) — all `agy-dart_fast` and `agy-dart_context` MCP tools, hooks, and Sidecar dashboard features work identically with lower Turn-0 discovery overhead (`0` custom agent metadata tokens).
- Existing installs upgrading via `node scripts/install.mjs install` or Sidecar self-update automatically prune the retired `agents/` directory.

### 2. `#1890` Custom-Agent Quota Audit in `scripts/cache-audit.mjs`
- Added `auditCustomAgents()` scanning workspace ancestors up to `.git` root (`.agents/agents`, `.gemini/agents`, `.agent/agents`, `.agents/plugins/*/agents`) as well as global (`~/.gemini/config/agents`, `~/.agents/agents`) and enabled plugin `agents/*.md` files.
- Emits `warn` (`custom_agent_quota_multiplier`, `category: "agents"`) for active custom agents and downgrades frontmatter `description: DEPRECATED...` transition placeholders to `info` (`deprecated_custom_agent_placeholder`).
- Fully integrated with `workspace` vs `global` `scopeGroup` tagging, `--workspace-only` filtering, top-level `customAgents` JSON summary, and Markdown report output.

### Verification
- `npm test`: 411/411 passed (including zero-agent guard, `#1890` multi-scope audit tests, and `prefix-budget` fixture coverage)
- `npm run verify:pkg`, `npm run brief:check`, `npm run prefix:budget`: PASS (`runtime=79, devtools=7`, `agents metadata = 0 tok`)
- `agy plugin validate --strict --json .`: PASS (`0` findings)
